paragraphs.text:
Once the rain stops, you gather the students in the cave mouth 
and make a short inspirational speech to raise their spirits. Your 
party offers suggestions about the best way to proceed. Charlie 
and Bernard emphasize the advantages of the sheltered cave 
as a base to explore the local environment; Sylvia and Norman 
would like to keep moving.

If any of your party require healing, you may restore 1 hit point each. 
To explore the cave’s depths, go to 50. To look for interesting features 
in the vicinity, go to 98. To pack up and move on, go to 434.
